policy: Review every closed candidate set. Select only when ASV wording or an explicit mapped textual note distinguishes a reading; otherwise mark underdetermined and retain the base fallback. The base candidate is the SBLGNT reading.

decisions.evidence: ASV 'when we were children' renders a first-person plural imperfect; the middle form ἤμεθα and the active ἦμεν are indistinguishable in English, and the only note here is an alternative_rendering about 'rudiments/elements', which cannot decide a reading.
ASV 'into our hearts' renders ἡμῶν; ὑμῶν would have given 'your hearts'.
ASV ends 'then an heir through God' with nothing rendering διὰ Χριστοῦ, so it follows διὰ θεοῦ and not θεοῦ διὰ Χριστοῦ.
The variation is only the order of φύσει and μή; ASV 'them that by nature are no gods' renders both words and cannot show which stood first.

ASV 'ye desire to be in bondage over again' renders the infinitive without marking aspect; present δουλεύειν and aorist δουλεῦσαι yield the same English, and the note here is an alternative_rendering about 'rudiments/elements'.
ASV 'that which was a temptation to you in my flesh' makes the Galatians the ones tempted (πειρασμὸν ὑμῶν); the RP reading τὸν πειρασμόν μου would have given 'my temptation'.
ASV asks 'Where then is that gratulation of yourselves?' — an adverb of place rendering ποῦ, not the interrogative τίς ('What then...').
ASV has the present 'Where then is that gratulation'; the added imperfect ἦν would have been rendered 'was'.
ASV 'if possible, ye would have plucked out your eyes and given them to me' already renders the contrary-to-fact sense from εἰ δυνατόν with the aorist; the added ἄν leaves the English unchanged.
The variation is the presence of the article τό before the infinitive clause; ASV 'But it is good to be zealously sought' renders the clause the same either way.
ASV 'My little children' renders the diminutive τεκνία; plain τέκνα would have given 'my children'.
μέχρις and ἄχρι are synonymous temporal conjunctions; ASV 'until Christ be formed in you' renders either.
ASV 'is born through promise' is anarthrous; διὰ τῆς ἐπαγγελίας would have been rendered 'through the promise', as ASV elsewhere keeps the article.

ASV opens 'Now this Hagar is mount Sinai in Arabia' with the mild connective of δέ, not the causal γάρ ('For'); the mapped textual_variant note reports the γάρ-based 'For Sinai is a mountain in Arabia' as what other authorities read, i.e. not the text ASV rendered.
ASV 'for she is in bondage with her children' renders the causal γάρ; δέ would have given 'and' or 'but'.
ASV 'which is our mother' has nothing rendering the added πάντων ('the mother of us all').
ASV 'Now we, brethren ... are children of promise' renders ἡμεῖς ... ἐσμέν, and the mapped textual_variant note 'Many ancient authorities read ye' places the ὑμεῖς reading outside the ASV text.
ASV 'shall not inherit' renders the emphatic negation the same whether the verb is future κληρονομήσει or aorist subjunctive κληρονομήσῃ after οὐ μή.
ASV 'Wherefore, brethren' renders an inferential particle that either διό or ἄρα supports; no wording or note distinguishes them.
